notes.subject: 2026/future provider opportunity - Bingen Huckleberry Festival
notes.body: 2026 Huckleberry Festival is Sept. 11-13 at Daubenspeck Park in Bingen WA. Official site lists bingenhuckleberryfestival@gmail.com and 509-493-3607. The event already promotes children's activities and family entertainment, so outreach should not assume they need to replace anyone. Ask whether they still have room or a need this year. Because this is a last-minute opportunity, explain both workable models without over-pushing either one: prepaid means the event pays the package fee and guests enjoy the attractions free; pay-for-play can also work, with Adventure Zone charging the public to play and paying the event a percentage of ticket-box sales. If 2026 is already set, ask to be considered for 2027 or another future event. Washington is weather-restricted, not on hold, so weather should be considered but should not automatically rule out pay-for-play for this last-minute route fill. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found for this Bingen event.

followUps.label: Bingen 2026/future follow-up
followUps.reason: Do not write off 2026. Present prepaid and pay-for-play as both workable last-minute options; if this year is set, keep the conversation open for 2027/future events.
